title: Versammlungsgeschehen zu einem angezeigten Aufzug anlässlich des 10. Muharram

extraction.summaryEn: A registered procession ("Aschura-Marsch") with up to about 600 participants ran from the Berliner Dom to Gendarmenmarkt. Police banned a re-enactment involving children, several people needed medical care for heat-related illness, and the event remained peaceful.
